secrets.name: THREE_MIN_API_SANDBOX_KEY
secrets.description: Sandbox API key for the 3Min order provider (starts with tm_test_). Only needed to enable the public /order sandbox form. Get it from the 3Min API provider dashboard.

secrets.name: THREE_MIN_API_URL
secrets.description: Sandbox endpoint URL for the 3Min order provider (https://api.3minapi.com/api/v1/data/<id>). Only needed to enable the public /order sandbox form.
